meta.note: Numbers extracted from actual downloaded documents unless key contains 'secondary' (cited by another verified document). Pages refer to PDF pages or article sections.

findings.cite: Milkman KL, Beshears J, Choi JJ, Laibson D, Madrian BC (2011). Using implementation intentions prompts to enhance influenza vaccination rates. PNAS 108(26):10415-20.
findings.data: Field RCT, employees of a large US firm offered free on-site flu shots; 3 arms of reminder mailers (control / date-plan / date+time-plan); N≈3,272
findings.method: Randomized field experiment; outcome = vaccination at workplace clinic

numbers.note: larger effect at sites with single-day clinics (short window)

findings.durability: One-shot behavior (single vaccination window); no persistence measured.
findings.interpretation_ja: 「日付と時刻を書き込む」計画欄をリマインダーに付けるだけで接種率が33.1%→37.1%（+4pp, 相対+12%）。日付だけでは有意差なし。計画の具体性が効く。機会が短期間に限られるほど効果大。

findings.cite: Cooke R, et al. (2023). The effect of forming implementation intentions on alcohol consumption: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Drug Alcohol Rev 42(1):68-80.
findings.data: 16 studies (random-effects meta-analysis)
findings.method: Meta-analysis of RCTs
findings.durability: Effects diminished with longer follow-up (meta-regression B=0.02/unit time); longest follow-up 24 weeks.
findings.interpretation_ja: if-then計画は飲酒量をわずかに減らす（d≈-0.14）が、オンライン実施や大学生では効果ほぼゼロ、時間経過で減衰。Gollwitzer & Sheeran (2006) のd≈0.65は近年の実地研究ではかなり小さくなる。

findings.cite: Silva MAV, et al. (2018). Impact of implementation intentions on physical activity practice in adults: systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs. PLoS One 13(11):e0206294.
findings.data: 13 RCTs, adults 18-76 incl. patients
findings.method: Random-effects meta-analysis
findings.durability: Effect found mainly when implementation-intention strategy was reinforced (boosters).
findings.interpretation_ja: 運動の実施計画（いつ・どこで）を立てさせる介入は、繰り返し強化した場合に小さな効果（SMD 0.25）。一度きりの計画では効果が弱い。

findings.cite: Giles EL, Robalino S, McColl E, Sniehotta FF, Adams J (2014). The effectiveness of financial incentives for health behaviour change: systematic review and meta-analysis. PLoS One 9(3):e90347.
findings.data: 16 studies (smoking n=10, vaccination/screening n=5, PA n=1)
findings.method: Meta-analysis + meta-regression
findings.durability: RR falls from 2.48 (≤6 months) to 1.50 (>6 months) for smoking: about 2/3 of the log-effect lost after incentives end; limited evidence effect decreases with longer post-intervention follow-up.
findings.interpretation_ja: 金銭インセンティブは健康行動を約1.6倍にする。禁煙では短期2.5倍→長期1.5倍に縮小（終了後に効果が大きく剥落）。単発行動（検診・ワクチン）では約1.9倍。

findings.cite: Volpp KG, John LK, Troxel AB, Norton L, Fassbender J, Loewenstein G (2008). Financial incentive-based approaches for weight loss: a randomized trial. JAMA 300(22):2631-7.
findings.data: 57 obese veterans (BMI 30-40), Philadelphia VA; 16-week intervention, follow-up to 7 months
findings.method: 3-arm RCT: monthly weigh-in control vs daily lottery (1/5 chance $10, 1/100 chance $100) vs deposit contract (own money matched 1:1)
findings.durability: Significant at 4 months (end of incentive) but NOT at 7 months; substantial regain after incentives stopped (lottery retained ~9.2-4.4=4.8 lb of 9.2 lb excess, deposit ~1.8 of 10.1 lb excess).
findings.interpretation_ja: くじ型（変動報酬）も預託金型（コミットメント）も16週で約13-14ポンド減（対照3.9）と同程度に強力。しかし報酬終了後3か月でリバウンドし、7か月時点では有意差消失。

findings.cite: Halpern SD, French B, Small DS, et al. (2015). Randomized trial of four financial-incentive programs for smoking cessation. NEJM 372(22):2108-17.
findings.data: 2,538 CVS Caremark employees + friends/family
findings.method: RCT: individual/group × reward(~$800)/deposit($150 + $650 reward) vs usual care
findings.durability: At 12 months (6 months after incentives ended) roughly half of 6-month abstainers remained abstinent; only reward-based programs stayed superior to usual care.
findings.interpretation_ja: 自分のお金を預ける（コミットメント）型は効果が強いが参加を選ぶのは13.7%だけ。報酬型は90%が受け入れ、結果的に集団全体の禁煙率は報酬型が上。インセンティブ終了半年後には成功者の約半数が再喫煙。

findings.cite: Royer H, Stehr M, Sydnor J (2015). Incentives, commitments and habit formation in exercise: evidence from a field experiment with workers at a Fortune-500 company. AEJ: Applied 7(3):51-84 (NBER WP 18580, 2012).
findings.data: ~1,000 employees of a Fortune-500 firm; 1-month incentive $10/visit (max 3/week); 2-year observation
findings.method: Field RCT: control / incentive only / incentive + optional self-funded commitment contract
findings.durability: Incentive-only: 25% of increase remains 1st month after, mostly gone by month 2, zero by weeks 14-52 (except ~3-4pp among prior non-users). Incentive+commitment: 45% retained in weeks 5-13, +25% attendance vs control still at weeks 14-52.
findings.interpretation_ja: 1か月の運動報酬でジム通いは倍増するが、終了1か月後に効果の25%、2か月後にはほぼ消滅。自腹のコミットメント契約を選べるようにすると1年後も+25%が残る。ただしコミットメントを選ぶのは12%程度。
findings.page: NBER WP pdf p.5 (intro), p.19-21 (Table 2 text), p.23 (take-up)

findings.cite: Aoki K, et al. (2026). Financial Incentives to Promote Physical Activity in Japan: A Rapid Review. J Prim Care Community Health 17:21501319261415805.
findings.data: 14 Japanese studies (11 peer-reviewed, 3 gray incl. Yokohama Walking Point); incentives ¥11-¥100/day mostly redeemable points/gift certificates
findings.method: Rapid review; descriptive synthesis of step-count change, ROI

numbers.western_meta_607_steps_secondary: meta of 23 RCTs: +607 steps/day (Mitchell et al. 2020, cited as ref 4)

findings.durability: Effects sustained while incentives continued (up to ~1 year); only 1 study measured post-withdrawal and found step increases NOT maintained after incentive ended.
findings.interpretation_ja: 日本の健康ポイント型（1日10〜100円相当）で歩数は平均+約1000歩/日。金額の大小と効果は無関係（少額でよい）。ポイント継続中は1年程度維持されるが、終了後は維持されないとの報告。

findings.cite: Kimmel SE, Troxel AB, Loewenstein G, et al. (2012). Randomized trial of lottery-based incentives to improve warfarin adherence. Am Heart J 164(2):268-74.
findings.data: 100 warfarin patients, 6 months
findings.method: RCT daily lottery incentive vs none
findings.durability: Not measured post-intervention.
findings.interpretation_ja: 毎日のくじ型インセンティブは全体では服薬管理を改善せず（OR 0.93, 有意差なし）。もともと服薬が悪い層にだけ効く（OR 0.39）。くじは万能ではなく、改善余地のある層で効果。

findings.cite: Karlan D, McConnell M, Mullainathan S, Zinman J (2016). Getting to the Top of Mind: How Reminders Increase Saving. Management Science 62(12):3393-3411 (NBER WP 16205, 2010).
findings.data: 3 field experiments, new commitment-savings account holders; monthly SMS or letter reminders
findings.method: Randomized field experiments
findings.durability: Measured over account horizon (months); repeated monthly reminders still effective; decay with repetition not separately estimated.
findings.interpretation_ja: 毎月のSMS・手紙リマインダーで貯蓄目標達成率+3%、貯蓄額+6%。具体的な使い道（学費など）に触れるリマインダーは効果が約2倍。注意の限界（忘れる）がリマインダーで補える。
findings.page: NBER WP pdf p.6 (Introduction, section text p.4)

findings.cite: Allcott H, Rogers T (2014). The Short-Run and Long-Run Effects of Behavioral Interventions: Experimental Evidence from Energy Conservation. AER 104(10):3003-37 (NBER WP 18492, 2012).
findings.data: Opower home energy reports, 3 long-running RCT sites (>6 million households receive reports nationally)
findings.method: Randomized continuation vs discontinuation after ~2 years

numbers.pattern: initial reports cause 'action and backsliding' cycles that attenuate over time; slow habituation—households still respond after 2 years

findings.durability: If reports stop after 2 years, effect decays only 10-20%/year (persistent 'capital stock' of habits/appliances); repeated treatment keeps working (little habituation).
findings.interpretation_ja: 繰り返し届く省エネ通知（社会比較フィードバック）は、最初は届くたびに行動→元に戻るの繰り返し。2年続けた後に止めても効果は年10〜20%しか減らない。長く続けるほど習慣化して持続。※数値詳細は本文フォント抽出不可のため要旨のみ。

findings.cite: Ito K, Ida T, Tanaka M (2018). Moral Suasion and Economic Incentives: Field Experimental Evidence from Energy Demand. AEJ: Economic Policy 10(1):240-67 (NBER WP 20910, 2015).
findings.data: ~690 households, 30-min smart-meter data, summer 2012 & winter 2013 critical-peak days
findings.method: Field RCT: moral suasion requests vs dynamic critical-peak pricing (65-105 cents/kWh) vs control

numbers.moral_suasion_reset_after_break: effect partially reset after months-long break

findings.durability: Moral suasion habituates quickly (8%→3%→0 over repeated requests); price incentives persistent across repetitions and ~half of effect (≈7%) persisted 3 months after final intervention (habit formation).
findings.interpretation_ja: 日本の節電実験：『お願い（道徳的説得）』は初回8%減→2回目3%→以降ほぼ0と急速に慣れる。価格インセンティブは15%減を繰り返しても維持、終了3か月後も約7%減が残る（習慣化）。
findings.page: NBER WP pdf p.4 (intro), p.17 (Table: cycles), p.20 (post-period)

findings.cite: 厚生労働省（2019）『受診率向上施策ハンドブック（第2版）』事例：東京都八王子市 大腸がんリピート検診（平成28年度）
findings.data: 前年度大腸がん検診受診者で検査キット送付対象 A群 n=1,761（利得メッセージ）, B群 n=1,761（損失メッセージ）; 平成28年10月時点
findings.method: 2-arm randomized message test by municipality (gain vs loss framing)

numbers.subgroups: 40代女性・50代男性で10pt以上の差

findings.durability: Single screening season; not reported.
findings.interpretation_ja: 「受診しないと来年は検査キットが届かなくなります」という損失フレームで受診率22.7%→29.9%（+7.2pt）。既得の便益を失うと伝えると動く。
findings.page: p.9 (事例 東京都八王子市)

findings.cite: 厚生労働省（2019）『受診率向上施策ハンドブック（第2版）』事例：東京都立川市 乳がん検診の再受診勧奨「受診計画カード」
findings.data: 乳がん検診未受診者を未受診理由で3群に分け個別メッセージ; 計画カード同封群
findings.method: Municipal message trial (comparison with conventional message)

numbers.relative: 約3倍の受診率（従来メッセージ比）

findings.durability: Not reported.
findings.interpretation_ja: 受診日を書き込む「受診計画カード」で乳がん再受診率が18.2pt改善（約3倍）。実行意図（いつ行くか決めさせる）の日本自治体版。厳密なRCTかは資料からは不明。
findings.page: p.13 (事例 東京都立川市)

findings.cite: 厚生労働省（2019）『受診率向上施策ハンドブック（第2版）』事例：千葉市 特定健診受診勧奨（平成29年度）
findings.data: 不定期受診者・未受診者向け勧奨案内の改善
findings.method: Municipal before/after with message redesign
findings.durability: Not reported.
findings.interpretation_ja: 特定健診の案内を「最初の一歩（どこで受けるか）」に絞って改善し全体受診率+3.7pt。

findings.cite: 溝田友里・山本精一郎（2023）がん検診受診勧奨におけるナッジ等の行動科学の有用性. 日本健康教育学会誌 31(2):83-92.
findings.data: 2015-2018, nudge/social-marketing invitation materials sent to 4.3 million residents in 787 municipalities; 167 municipalities with year-on-year data
findings.method: Dissemination study; before/after vs previous year (no randomized control)
findings.durability: TV-linked campaign effects observed over 3 months after broadcast.
findings.interpretation_ja: ナッジ型受診勧奨資材を全国787市町村・430万人に展開、データのある167市町村の83%で受診率が上昇、平均+2.6pt（1.44倍）。全国展開時の現実的な効果量はこの程度。

findings.cite: 加藤大貴・佐々木周作・大竹文雄（2022）回帰不連続デザインによる風しん予防対策の効果検証―抗体検査・ワクチン接種の無料クーポン券の自動送付―. RIETI DP 22-J-011.
findings.data: National online survey; men 40-57; FY2019 coupons auto-mailed to age 40-46, opt-in application for 47+
findings.method: Regression discontinuity at age cutoff
findings.durability: Cumulative uptake within program year.
findings.interpretation_ja: 無料クーポンを自動送付（申請不要）にするだけで抗体検査受検率が約16pt上昇。手間（申請）を取り除く効果は大きい。
findings.page: p.6 (要旨/はじめに); 本文 p.~20

findings.cite: 加藤大貴・佐々木周作・大竹文雄（2022）風しんの抗体検査とワクチン接種を促進するためのナッジ・メッセージの探究―全国規模オンライン・フィールド実験による効果検証―. RIETI DP 22-J-010.
findings.data: National online RCT, men in target cohort
findings.method: Online RCT with follow-up survey of actual behavior

numbers.opt_in_cohort: no significant effect of any message

findings.durability: Behavior measured at follow-up survey (months later).
findings.interpretation_ja: 「妊婦と胎児を守る」利他的メッセージで受検意向+14.3pt、実際の受検は+7.5pt（意向→行動で約半分に縮む）。申請が必要な層ではどのメッセージも無効。

findings.cite: Sasaki S, Kurokawa H, Ohtake F (2021). Effective but fragile? Responses to repeated nudge-based messages for preventing the spread of COVID-19 infection. Japanese Economic Review 72(3):371-408.
findings.data: 4-wave online panel experiment Apr-Aug 2020, N=4,241, 5 message types
findings.method: Repeated randomized message exposure
findings.durability: Behavioral effect of the only effective message disappeared by waves 3-4 (1-3 months later) despite repeated display, while intentions were still reinforced (intention-behavior gap); adverse effect for already-compliant subgroup.
findings.interpretation_ja: 同じナッジ・メッセージを繰り返し見せても、行動への効果は1〜3か月で消える（意向は上がり続けても行動は伴わない）。既に行動できている人には逆効果も。

findings.cite: 大竹文雄・中村文香・杉山巧馬（2026）感染症発生届出促進ナッジ. RIETI DP 26-J-011.
findings.data: Online survey RCT of physicians; 3-month follow-up
findings.method: RCT with follow-up
findings.durability: Immediate effect +20 to +44pp on intention; fully disappeared at 3-month follow-up.
findings.interpretation_ja: 医師への届出促進メッセージで直後の届出意思は20〜44pt上昇するが、3か月後には効果ゼロ。一回きりの情報提供ナッジは短命。

findings.cite: Kim J, et al. (2021). Effects of Gamification on Behavioral Change in Education: A Meta-Analysis. IJERPH 18(7):3550.
findings.data: Controlled experimental studies 2010-2019 in educational settings
findings.method: Random-effects meta-analysis
findings.durability: Strong novelty decay: <1 week d=1.57, ≤20 weeks d=0.30, multi-year d=-0.20 (adverse).
findings.interpretation_ja: バッジ・ランキング等のゲーミフィケーションは平均d≈0.48の効果。ただし1週間未満ならd=1.57、20週でd=0.30、数年続けるとマイナス。新奇性効果で急速に減衰。

findings.cite: Tanji F, Tomata Y, Abe S, et al. (2020). Effect of a financial incentive (shopping point) on increasing the number of daily walking steps among community-dwelling adults in Japan: a randomised controlled trial. BMJ Open 10(11):e037303.
findings.data: 72 physically inactive adults (69% women, mean age 61; baseline 6,364 steps/day); local shopping points worth ¥1,000-2,000 (~US$9-18) for meeting step targets
findings.method: 2-arm RCT (wait-list control); baseline wk1-3, incentive wk4-6, follow-up wk7-9 after incentive removed
findings.durability: Between-group difference fell from +1,136 steps/day during incentive to +377 (ns, p=0.31) in the 3 weeks after removal (~1/3 retained, not significant).
findings.interpretation_ja: 仙台の買い物ポイント（最大2000円）で歩数が+1650歩（対照+514歩）。ポイント終了後3週間で群間差は約1/3に縮み有意差消失。少額ポイントは短期には効くが持続しない。

findings.cite: Sailer M, Homner L (2020). The Gamification of Learning: a Meta-analysis. Educational Psychology Review 32(1):77-112.
findings.data: k=19 (cognitive, N=1,686), k=16 (motivational, N=2,246), k=9 (behavioral, N=951)
findings.method: Random-effects meta-analysis

numbers.moderators: game fiction and competition+collaboration more effective for behavioral outcomes; motivational/behavioral effects less stable in high-rigor subsplit

findings.durability: Period of time tested as moderator; not reported as post-intervention persistence.
findings.interpretation_ja: 学習のゲーミフィケーション効果は小さい（認知g=0.49、動機g=0.36、行動g=0.25）。厳密な研究では動機・行動面の効果は不安定。競争＋協力の組み合わせが有効。

findings.cite: Moldon L, Strohmaier M, Wachs J (2021). How Gamification Affects Software Developers: Cautionary Evidence from a Natural Experiment on GitHub. ICSE 2021 (arXiv:2006.02371).
findings.data: GitHub contribution logs around unannounced removal of streak counters (May 2016); streaks started early 2016 vs early 2017
findings.method: Natural experiment; regression discontinuity; survival curves
findings.durability: Removing the streak display immediately shortened streaks: very long (100+ day) streaks fell by more than half; behavior sustained only by the counter disappears when it is removed.
findings.interpretation_ja: 連続記録（ストリーク）表示を消すと、100日超の長期連続が4.4%→2.0%に半減、平均連続日数26→22日。『最低限だけやって記録をつなぐ日』も減少。ストリークは行動を強く維持させるが、表示がなくなると即座に剥がれる。

findings.cite: Vetrovsky T, et al. (2022). Do physical activity interventions combining self-monitoring with other components provide an additional benefit compared with self-monitoring alone? A systematic review and meta-analysis. Br J Sports Med 56(23):1366-1374.
findings.data: 85 RCTs, 12,057 participants (75 at post-intervention, 24 at follow-up)
findings.method: Random-effects meta-analysis + meta-regression; active control = self-monitoring alone

PACE_UP_example.note: pedometer self-monitoring effect maintained to 3 years (cited)

findings.durability: Net effect of extra components roughly halves at follow-up (926→413 steps, median ~3 months). Self-monitoring+goal alone (PACE-UP) maintained to 9 months and up to 3 years.
findings.interpretation_ja: 歩数計で自己記録＋目標設定が基本形。そこに追加要素（電話カウンセリング等）を足すと+926歩/日、終了後（中央値3か月）は+413歩/日へ半減。具体的な目標を与えるだけで約+600歩。セルフモニタリング＋目標は安価で持続性も比較的高い。

findings.cite: Synthesis of commitment-device take-up rates reported in Royer, Stehr & Sydnor (NBER WP 18580, p.23) and Halpern et al. (2015, NEJM)
findings.data: Take-up of voluntary commitment devices when offered
findings.method: Field experiments (offered option)

numbers.note: Gine/Ashraf figures as cited by Royer et al. p.23 (secondary, not verified from original)

findings.durability: Commitment raises persistence for those who take it (Royer: +25% gym attendance 1 year later), but only ~10-30% of offered people choose it.
findings.interpretation_ja: 自分を縛る仕組み（預託金・コミットメント契約）を自ら選ぶ人は提示された人の約1〜3割（ジム12%、禁煙11〜14%、貯蓄28%）。選んだ人には効くが、普及の天井が低い。

Bryan, Karlan & Nelson (2010) Commitment Devices review

Mazeas A et al. (2022) gamification & physical activity meta-analysis (JMIR)
Cochrane 2024: SMS text messaging for CVD medication adherence
JAMA Netw Open 2023: reduction of financial health incentives (Vitality) and change in physical activity — direct evidence on effect after incentive cut
Management Science 2022: Health wearables, gamification and healthful activity
Hachioji SIB / nudge & ML cancer screening (IJERPH 2020)
Hepatitis screening uptake at Japanese worksites with nudge + full subsidy (EHPM 2021)

よこはまウォーキングポイント 参加者数・歩数集計報告

not_found: Original Gollwitzer & Sheeran 2006 d=0.65 and Sheeran et al. later meta-analyses: not on allowed open hosts (only alcohol & PA II meta-analyses verified).
Harkin 2016 and Epton 2017 meta-analyses (APA journals): not accessible; topic 2 covered by Vetrovsky 2022 self-monitoring meta-analysis instead.
SMarT (Thaler & Benartzi 2004) 3.5%→13.6% and Bryan/Karlan/Nelson 2010: not on allowed hosts; values unverified.
Mitchell 2020 meta (financial incentives for PA): PMC search found no hit; +607 steps/day only as secondary citation.
Loyalty/points program meta-analysis (purchase frequency, share of wallet): none found on allowed hosts.
